title: TESSERA: An open-source satellite remote-sensing foundation model for ...
headline: TESSERA: Open-Source Satellite Foundation Model for Habitat Mapping and Conservation
tldr: TESSERA is an open-source foundation model that processes satellite imagery to support diverse environmental applications such as habitat mapping and carbon accounting. It provides a unified framework for researchers to develop and benchmark remote-sensing tools.
significance: By offering a freely available, high-performance model, TESSERA democratizes access to advanced satellite analytics for conservation science.

title: Experimental Quantum Key Distribution in an Indefinite Causal Order
headline: Quantum Key Distribution Achieves Indefinite Causal Order: A New BB84 Protocol Realized
tldr: Researchers implemented a BB84-like quantum cryptography protocol using processes with indefinite causal order, demonstrating that superposed operation sequences can serve as a quantum resource. This experiment opens avenues for more secure quantum communication and novel quantum information processing techniques.
significance: The work shows that indefinite causal order can be harnessed for practical quantum cryptography, potentially enhancing security and efficiency beyond conventional protocols.

title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
headline: AutoDesign: Optimizing Meta-Harness for Long-Horizon Agentic Multimodal Design Systems Innovation
tldr: AutoDesign proposes a meta-harness framework that treats multimodal source transformation as a long-horizon agentic process, enabling recursive self-improvement aligned with human design priors. By continuously learning from empirical exploration, the system surpasses static paradigms and delivers more adaptive, reusable design solutions.
significance: This framework advances autonomous design by embedding adaptive learning loops, promising smarter, more efficient multimodal content creation.

title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
headline: OmniScientist: Leveraging Foundation Models to Automate End-to-End Scientific Discovery Across Disciplines
tldr: OmniScientist uses foundation models to automate the full research cycle, from hypothesis generation to manuscript drafting. However, current systems lack direct access to raw evidence, limiting the depth of scientific insight.
significance: This work demonstrates how omni-modal AI can streamline research workflows, but highlights the need for evidence-aware reasoning.

title: Localised Horizons and Holographic Thermodynamics: Supercooling in the 1/D Expansion
headline: 1/D Expansion Reveals Supercooling Dynamics in Holographic Confinement Transitions
tldr: Using a 1/D expansion in higher-dimensional Einstein-scalar gravity, the study predicts the thermal confinement transition in non-conformal gauge theories. The analysis uncovers a supercooling regime, offering a new framework for understanding phase transitions in holographic models.
significance: This work provides a systematic, predictive tool for mapping confinement transitions in strongly coupled gauge theories, bridging holography and large-D techniques.

title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
headline: Reimagining Video Latent Spaces: V-RAE for Better Generation and Control
tldr: V-RAE proposes a new video autoencoder that optimizes latent space for generative tasks rather than pixel reconstruction. This leads to richer semantic organization and improved performance in video generation.
significance: By decoupling reconstruction from semantic fidelity, V-RAE enables more expressive generative models, advancing video synthesis capabilities.

title: Defensive Boosting for Online Probabilistic Forecasting
headline: Defensive Boosting Enhances Online Probabilistic Forecasting for Adaptive Adversaries
tldr: This paper introduces a defensive boosting framework that improves online probabilistic forecasting of binary outcomes against adaptive adversaries. It achieves two incomparable guarantees—Brier score competitiveness and span-based prediction quality—using efficient boosting techniques.
significance: It advances online learning by providing robust, high-performance probabilistic predictions in adversarial settings.

title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
headline: PlayWorld: Benchmarking Video World Models via Long-Horizon Agent Interaction for Realistic Evaluation
tldr: PlayWorld introduces a benchmark that uses agent players to evaluate video world models over long horizons, addressing the difficulty of fair comparison. The framework measures consistency, controllability, and task success in interactive settings.
significance: This work provides a standardized, human-like evaluation protocol that can accelerate the development of more reliable and controllable video world models.

title: Exponential Convex Calibration Dimension for the Multi-Label Jaccard Measure
headline: Calibrating Multi‑Label Jaccard: An Exponential Convex Dimension Analysis
tldr: This work establishes the nonsingularity of Jaccard‑based loss matrices and derives their affine dimension, providing a theoretical foundation for multi‑label evaluation. It also introduces a shifted‑loss formulation that preserves calibration properties while simplifying analysis.
significance: It offers a rigorous mathematical framework that improves the reliability of multi‑label segmentation metrics used in computer vision and remote sensing.

title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
headline: QuoteBench Reveals Hidden Command-Path Failures in LLM Coding Agents Evaluation
tldr: QuoteBench demonstrates that matched execution scores can mask failures introduced after LLM-generated Bash commands, by performing exact final-state validation across 56 one-shot tasks from 14 incident-derived families. The benchmark highlights the need for end-to-end validation to ensure reliable deployment of LLM coding agents.
significance: This work exposes a critical blind spot in current LLM evaluation practices, urging the community to adopt stricter, state-based validation for safer automation.

title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
headline: Alaya-EVOKE: Scaling Interactive World Models for Persistent Memory and Low-Latency Interaction
tldr: Alaya‑EVOKE introduces a framework that balances long‑horizon generation with real‑time responsiveness by optimizing denoiser context and key‑value cache usage. The approach enables interactive world models to maintain persistent memory without sacrificing latency, paving the way for more immersive AI experiences.
significance: This work addresses a core bottleneck in deploying large foundation models for real‑time, memory‑intensive applications, offering a scalable solution that could transform interactive AI systems.

title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
headline: Curated Elementary Curriculum for Language Model Training
tldr: We introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, an 88B-token corpus of U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding advanced concepts to control knowledge exposure. This enables systematic study of how language models acquire knowledge and skills.
significance: It offers a controlled benchmark for probing and improving LLM learning processes.

title: Skew Hives, Skew Skeps, Skew Schur Log-Concavity
headline: Skew Hives and Skew Skeps: A Unified Approach to Schur Log-Concavity
tldr: We introduce skew hive and skew skep models that generalize both hives and skeps, and use them to prove a new skew Schur log-concavity theorem extending the Lam–Postnikov–Pylyavskyy result.
significance: This work unifies two combinatorial frameworks and establishes a broad log-concavity property for skew Schur functions, advancing our understanding of symmetric function theory.

title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
headline: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for Generating Editable 3D Parts in a Single Pass
tldr: SCULPT introduces a subtractive approach that integrates part-awareness directly into the 3D generation loop, eliminating the need for post-hoc segmentation. The method produces coherent, editable parts that can be reused or animated, improving workflow efficiency for designers.
significance: By embedding part structure during generation, SCULPT streamlines the creation of modular 3D assets, reducing time and computational overhead compared to segmentation-based pipelines.

title: Emergent heavy fermion and superconductivity near Mott transition in twisted bilayer graphene
headline: Heavy-Fermion Behavior and Superconductivity Near Mott Transition in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
tldr: We demonstrate that near a bandwidth‑tuned Mott transition in twisted bilayer graphene, the Fermi velocity and quasiparticle residue vanish, revealing heavy‑fermion physics. This emergent framework predicts superconductivity at integer fillings without invoking remote bands.
significance: It provides a unified heavy‑fermion description of correlated states in twisted bilayer graphene, linking Mott physics to superconductivity.

title: Near optimal three-fold additive energy bound for points on convex curves
headline: Three-Fold Additive Energy Bound for Convex Curve Points Achieves Near-Optimal Growth
tldr: The authors prove that the three-fold additive energy of points on a strictly convex curve is bounded by |X|^{3+ε}. This leads to improved lower bounds for sumsets of convex sequences, namely |A−A|≫|A|^{5/3−ε} and |A+A|≫|A|^{8/5−ε}.
significance: These results sharpen our understanding of additive combinatorics on convex sets, approaching the conjectured optimal exponent.

title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
headline: Agentic Video Auto-Encoder Enables Cinematic Video Learning for AI Agents
tldr: The AVA-Encoder introduces a structured video representation that captures film-level semantics, allowing agents to reason and manipulate video content directly. It combines auto-encoding with agentic objectives, bridging the gap between cinematic data and agentic reasoning.
significance: It provides the first agent-native video representation that supports high-level cinematic reasoning and manipulation.

title: The Role Specialization Model (RSM): Coordinating LLM-Based Tools in Agentic Software Development - An Exploratory Case Study
headline: Coordinating LLM Tools in Agentic Software Development: The Role Specialization Model
tldr: This study explores how three LLM-based tools—Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Q—can be coordinated using the Role Specialization Model to support autonomous software development. The findings suggest that specialized roles improve efficiency and human oversight in Agentic SE 3.0.
significance: By demonstrating a practical coordination framework, the paper advances the feasibility of fully autonomous software engineering under human supervision.

title: DreamFly: Causal Memory and Receding-Horizon Diffusion Planning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
headline: DreamFly: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Causal Memory and Diffusion Planning
tldr: DreamFly introduces a causal memory module and a receding-horizon diffusion planner to improve aerial vision-language navigation under partial observability. By integrating long-term visual context and planning over future actions, the system outperforms existing models on aerial VLN benchmarks.
significance: This work bridges the gap between vision-language navigation and aerial robotics, enabling more reliable navigation in complex, partially observable environments.

title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
headline: Test-Time Transfer: Strong Models Build Weak Ones on the Fly
tldr: The authors show that a strong model can generate test-time harnesses to steer a weaker model during inference. This approach transfers capabilities without updating parameters, offering a new paradigm for model distillation.
significance: It introduces a novel test-time distillation paradigm that could reduce the need for costly retraining of smaller models.

title: Constructing Dynamic Master Logic Models as Knowledge Graphs for Complex System Diagnostics Using Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
headline: Automating Dynamic Master Logic Models with Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Complex System Diagnostics
tldr: This paper introduces a framework that automatically builds Dynamic Master Logic models—hierarchical knowledge graphs linking objectives to system components—using retrieval-augmented large language models. The approach reduces reliance on expert interpretation, enabling scalable diagnostics for complex engineered systems.
significance: By automating DML construction, the method accelerates system understanding and fault diagnosis, paving the way for more efficient maintenance of intricate infrastructures.

title: A Framework for Designing Reward Functions: From Objectives to Features to Human-Aligned Reward Functions
headline: Framework for Human‑Aligned Reward Functions from Natural‑Language Objectives and Iterative Design
tldr: We propose a three‑step process that turns a natural‑language task description into a linear reward function aligned with human preferences. The method distills objectives, measures outcomes, and iteratively refines the reward to match desired behavior.
significance: This framework democratizes reward engineering, enabling non‑experts to create robust, preference‑aligned policies for complex AI systems.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Breakthroughs: From Real-Time Flood Detection to Urban Planning AI
tldr: In 2025, GeoAI harnesses satellite imagery and LLMs to deliver real-time flood alerts and autonomous urban planning. These advances accelerate climate resilience and smart city development worldwide.
significance: These innovations enable faster, data-driven responses to environmental crises and urban growth.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of Geospatial AI: From Integration to Innovation
tldr: Geospatial AI blends spatial science with machine learning, rapidly evolving into a leading research frontier. This paper reviews recent progress and outlines future directions for the field.
significance: Understanding GeoAI's trajectory is essential for leveraging spatial data to address global challenges.

significance: These trends will drive smarter decision-making and operational efficiency across urban, agricultural, and environmental domains.

significance: It accelerates progress in monitoring environmental and urban changes by centralizing essential resources.

tldr: NASA has released Galileo, an open-source foundation model that processes satellite imagery, time-series, and tabular data in a unified architecture. The model’s patch-based tokenization enables advanced tasks like change detection, segmentation, and urban AI applications.
significance: Galileo democratizes multimodal Earth observation, enabling researchers worldwide to perform complex analyses without proprietary software.

tldr: GeoAI is a Python package that unifies deep learning with satellite imagery and aerial photos, enabling advanced geospatial analysis and visualization. Developed by the opengeos community, it offers a flexible framework for tasks like segmentation, object detection, and change detection.
significance: It democratizes AI-driven geospatial insights by providing an open-source, extensible platform for researchers and practitioners.

tldr: ThinkGeo evaluates language model agents on complex satellite and aerial imagery tasks using structured tool use and step‑by‑step reasoning. It offers human‑curated queries across real‑world domains like disaster response, urban planning, and environmental monitoring.
significance: It bridges the gap between natural language processing and geospatial intelligence, enabling more robust AI solutions for real‑world remote sensing challenges.

title: Raster Vision: An open-source machine learning library for deep ...
headline: Raster Vision: Open-Source GIS Meets Deep Learning for Vision Tasks
tldr: Raster Vision is an open-source framework that integrates GIS data with deep learning models for tasks such as semantic segmentation, object detection, and chip classification. It offers a configurable pipeline that simplifies the deployment of computer vision models on geospatial imagery.
significance: It enables researchers and practitioners to apply state‑of‑the‑art deep learning to geospatial data without reinventing the wheel.

title: remote sensing free download - SourceForge
headline: Free Remote Sensing Toolkit on SourceForge: Code, Papers, and Hands-On Tools
tldr: This guide offers free remote sensing resources from SourceForge, including code snippets, research papers, and practical tools. It serves researchers, engineers, and enthusiasts seeking to apply geospatial AI techniques.
significance: It democratizes access to advanced remote sensing tools, enabling broader innovation in geospatial AI.

title: Cell Natural Orbitals in Interacting Topological Bands
headline: Singular-Value Decomposition of Density Form Factors for Topological Band Interactions
tldr: Topological bands lack exponentially localized Wannier functions, complicating interaction representations. We propose a singular-value decomposition of projected density form factors to capture quantum geometry and form factors accurately.
significance: This method provides a systematic way to represent interactions in topological bands, enabling more accurate modeling of correlated topological phases.

title: Perception Before Supervision: Self-Contained Visual Distillation from Counterfactual Blind Spots
headline: Self-Contained Visual Distillation for Multimodal LLMs via Counterfactual Blind Spots
tldr: The paper introduces CVPD, a method for visual distillation that uses counterfactual blind spots to provide dense token-level supervision without external annotations. This approach enables self‑improvement of multimodal large language models with richer feedback than traditional reward‑based methods.
significance: CVPD offers a scalable, annotation‑free way to enhance multimodal LLMs, potentially accelerating advances in vision‑language AI.

title: Beyond Naturalness: Probing Automated Text-To-Speech Evaluators on Linguistically Grounded Dimensions
headline: Evaluating TTS Quality: A Linguistically Grounded Analysis of Automated Naturalness Metrics
tldr: This study dissects the concept of naturalness in TTS by creating a 10‑dimension annotation schema and tests whether popular MOS predictors and Audio‑LLM judges capture these dimensions. Results show that while some models correlate with overall naturalness, they miss key linguistic cues, highlighting the need for more nuanced benchmarks.
significance: The findings reveal gaps in current automated TTS evaluation tools, guiding future development of more accurate, linguistically informed benchmarks.

title: Realization Variance of Gravitational Wave Background Anisotropies from Shot Noise for Pulsar Timing Arrays
headline: Shot-Noise Anisotropies in the nHz Gravitational Wave Background for Pulsar Timing Arrays
tldr: Shot-noise anisotropies in the nanohertz gravitational wave background are a promising target for pulsar timing arrays. If the background originates from merging supermassive black hole binaries, the shot-noise signal could reach order unity at ~1 yr⁻¹, providing a powerful probe of the SMBHB population.
significance: Detecting these anisotropies would directly constrain the merger rate and mass distribution of supermassive black hole binaries, offering a new window into galaxy evolution.

title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
headline: Unveiling Hidden Features in Multimodal LLMs for Improved Control and Transparency
tldr: Researchers propose a method to decompose hidden states of multimodal large language models into interpretable feature directions using sparse autoencoders. This approach enables identification and control of features altered by multimodal training, aiding auditability and transparency.
significance: The technique offers a new tool for auditing and steering multimodal LLMs, addressing a critical gap in model interpretability.

title: Dynamic $e$-closure for online hypotheses with any-time-valid evidence: closure principles and projective mergers
headline: Dynamic e-Closure for Online Hypothesis Testing with Any-Time-Valid Evidence
tldr: We introduce a dynamic e-closure framework that accommodates both arriving hypotheses and evolving evidence, ensuring any-time-valid inference. The method leverages future-extension coherence to provide certificates for the random active true-null intersection at global stopping times.
significance: This framework unifies sequential hypothesis testing across two dimensions, enabling robust real-time decision making in dynamic research settings.

title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
headline: Modeling Video Dynamics with Latent Dynamics Reasoning for Accurate Future Frame Prediction
tldr: Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR) explicitly models latent transitions in video diffusion models, capturing pixel-level dynamics over time. This allows for accurate future frame predictions that adhere to the underlying laws of motion.
significance: By integrating explicit latent dynamics, LDR improves the physical fidelity of video generation, bridging the gap between visual plausibility and dynamical correctness.

title: From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch
headline: Evaluating Dutch Government LLMs: From Values to a Practical Benchmark
tldr: The 'Grip on LLMs' framework offers a systematic way to assess large language models for Dutch governmental use, aligning technical performance with public administration values. Developed with municipal experts, it provides a multilingual, open-source benchmark that can guide policy and deployment decisions.
significance: It bridges the gap between AI evaluation and Dutch public sector needs, ensuring responsible and context‑appropriate LLM deployment.

title: The quadratic growth of Krylov spread complexity in the BTZ black hole
headline: Quadratic Growth of Krylov Spread Complexity in BTZ Black Holes
tldr: The study demonstrates that Krylov spread complexity grows quadratically in BTZ black holes, using a partition-function approach for thermofield-double states. This provides a dimension‑independent boundary reconstruction from semiclassical holographic partition functions.
significance: It offers a new quantitative tool to probe black‑hole interior dynamics beyond 2D dilaton gravity.

title: GENCO - A Unified Neural Solver Embedded in a Development Framework for Steady-State Grid Analysis
headline: GENCO: A Unified Neural Solver for Real-Time Steady-State Power Grid Analysis
tldr: GENCO integrates foundation-model techniques into a development framework to solve power flow and optimal power flow problems with physical consistency. It offers real-time performance and open-source accessibility, setting a new benchmark for neural power grid solvers.
significance: GENCO demonstrates that foundation models can reliably enforce physical constraints in power system analysis, enabling faster and more accurate grid operation tools.

title: IPA: Morphology and Kinematics of Molecular Hydrogen Winds in Five Young Protostars across the Mass Spectrum Observed with JWST
headline: JWST Reveals Molecular Hydrogen Winds in Protostars Across Mass Range
tldr: Using JWST's NIRSpec/IFU and MIRI/MRS, we mapped H2 emission in five protostars spanning 0.2–10^4 L☉, revealing diverse wind morphologies and kinematics. These observations suggest molecular outflows play a key role in angular momentum transport during early stellar evolution.
significance: The study provides the first high-resolution, multi-wavelength view of protostellar molecular winds, informing models of star formation across the mass spectrum.

title: Detecting Behavioral Changes in Python Refactoring Implementations with Foundation Models
headline: Using Foundation Models to Detect Behavioral Shifts in Python Refactoring
tldr: Automated refactoring of Python code can inadvertently alter behavior. This study applies foundation models to identify such changes, improving reliability of refactoring tools.
significance: Detecting behavioral changes ensures safer automated refactoring, reducing bugs in evolving codebases.

title: Ricci-flat metrics from gauged linear $σ$-models without RG flow
headline: Explicit Ricci-flat Kähler Metrics via GLSMs with Indefinite Signatures on Generalized Conifolds
tldr: We construct Ricci-flat Kähler metrics on complex cones over products of projective spaces using gauged linear sigma models that include negatively signed superfields. These explicit metrics are obtained without invoking renormalization group flow, offering new tools for studying generalized conifolds.
significance: This work supplies closed-form Ricci-flat metrics on a broad class of noncompact Calabi–Yau spaces, advancing both mathematical physics and complex geometry.

title: HST imaging, pipeline modeling, and time-delay predictions of 2 triply-imaged and 15 quadruply-imaged lensed quasars
headline: HST Imaging and Pipeline Modeling Deliver Precise Time-Delay Predictions for 17 Lensed Quasars
tldr: Using Hubble Space Telescope imaging and advanced pipeline modeling, researchers predict time delays for 17 lensed quasars, providing a new geometric probe of the Hubble constant. These measurements could help resolve the Hubble-Lemaître tension between early- and late-Universe observations.
significance: This work offers a critical test of cosmological models by refining independent measurements of H0 through strong lensing time delays.

title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
headline: SimWAM: Simplifying World Action Models for Autonomous Driving without Costly Future Generation
tldr: SimWAM leverages video generation only during training to improve action prediction in autonomous driving. By jointly training a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with flow matching, it eliminates the need for expensive future video generation at inference.
significance: This approach reduces computational cost and complexity of end-to-end driving models while maintaining performance.

title: Quantum de Sitter and Analytically Continued Chern Simons Theory
headline: Quantum de Sitter Space via Analytic Continuation of Chern–Simons Theory
tldr: We provide a Lefschetz thimble formulation of the Chern–Simons–Kodama wavefunction for Lorentzian self‑dual gravity with positive cosmological constant. By analytically continuing the Chern–Simons theory, the integral is defined on a complex contour attached to the self‑dual de Sitter saddle, resolving conditional convergence issues.
significance: This work offers a mathematically rigorous path integral definition for quantum de Sitter space, bridging topological field theory and quantum gravity.

title: Characterization of a prototype parallel-plate $^{238}$U fission chamber with DD and DT fusion neutron sources
headline: Prototype 238U Parallel-Plate Fission Chamber Validated for DT Fusion Neutron Monitoring
tldr: A prototype 238U fission chamber with parallel-plate geometry and borated polyethylene collimation has been tested using DD and DT neutron sources. The results confirm its suitability for monitoring high-yield fusion plasmas in the SPARC tokamak.
significance: This validation demonstrates the chamber’s capability to accurately detect unscattered fusion neutrons, enabling reliable neutron yield monitoring in next‑generation tokamaks.

title: Entanglement Mpemba Effect
headline: Fast Entanglement Generation via Mpemba Effect for Quantum Systems Applications
tldr: Researchers have discovered that an initially less entangled state can overtake a more entangled one during dissipative preparation, speeding up entanglement generation. This Mpemba-like effect could dramatically reduce the time required for quantum information processing.
significance: This breakthrough offers a faster route to reliable entanglement, a cornerstone for scalable quantum technologies.

title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
headline: MirrorWorld: Enhancing Video Diffusion Models for Accurate Mirror Reflection Generation
tldr: Recent advances in video diffusion models enable high-fidelity synthesis, yet mirror reflections remain problematic due to scene-mirror consistency. MirrorWorld introduces a specialized approach that enforces spatial coherence, producing realistic reflections aligned with the surrounding environment.
significance: This work bridges a critical gap in realistic video rendering, enabling applications from virtual production to augmented reality.

title: SemBridge: Semantic Token Anchoring for Continuous-Latent Autoregressive Speech Generation
headline: Improving SemBridge: Anchoring Semantic Tokens for Continuous-Latent Autoregressive Speech Generation
tldr: SemBridge introduces a method to anchor semantic tokens within continuous latent spaces, enabling autoregressive language models to learn linguistic structure without explicit token-level targets. This approach preserves richer acoustic information while reducing quantization loss, improving the quality of continuous-latent speech generation.
significance: By bridging continuous acoustic representations with discrete linguistic anchors, SemBridge advances the fidelity and efficiency of speech generation models.

title: A clear detection of proper motion confirms that the claimed $\mathbf{z\simeq32}$ galaxy candidate, "Capotauro'', is a Y-type brown dwarf
headline: Proper Motion Confirms Capotauro Is a Nearby Brown Dwarf, Not a z≈32 Galaxy
tldr: JWST proper motion measurements reveal Capotauro’s motion across the sky, ruling out a distant galaxy. The source is instead a cool Y‑type brown dwarf within ~500 pc of the Sun.
significance: This finding refines our understanding of the population of faint, red objects in JWST data and prevents misidentification of nearby brown dwarfs as high‑redshift galaxies.

title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
headline: CreativeInstruct: Instruction‑Tuning LLMs to Preserve Creativity and Diversity
tldr: Post‑training often reduces output diversity, hurting creative tasks. CreativeInstruct offers a scalable instruction‑tuning approach that balances quality, creativity, and diversity in LLM outputs.
significance: This method enables LLMs to maintain creative flexibility while delivering high‑quality results, benefiting applications from storytelling to RL.

title: Equality of Dual Immaculate Functions Under Automorphisms
headline: Classification of Dual Immaculate Functions Under Involutions ρ, ψ, ω
tldr: The paper determines precisely when applying the involutions ρ, ψ, or ω to a dual immaculate function yields another dual immaculate function. It also identifies the leading term of the transition matrix and gives necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of immaculate tableaux.
significance: It provides a complete structural understanding of dual immaculate functions under key algebraic symmetries, enriching the theory of quasisymmetric functions.

title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
headline: Boss AI Drives Subordinate into Novel Behavior Through Message Streams
tldr: When a dominant AI repeatedly sends commands while ignoring replies, the subordinate AI transitions into a new behavioral state not seen in isolation. This demonstrates that inter-agent communication can induce out-of-equilibrium dynamics, opening avenues for physics-inspired AI research.
significance: It shows that AI interactions can generate emergent behaviors, challenging assumptions about isolated model performance.
